event_order: successful command: check locks/range/mana, consume resource, arm cast triggers
AA: reserve identity/ammo/weapon, lock windup, queue flight
impact: damage using currently modeled stats and current HP, execute, grant stacks
equal-time heap insertion order; effects queued within an impact resolve after that impact
target death: discard remaining queued damage
remaining_order_uncertainty: same-time expiry versus hit WR parity
